steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Cartridge paper: 120-300 gsm, textured surface, good for sketching and marker work. | Key Fact: Corrugated board: two liner layers with fluted medium - excellent crush resistance, lightweight, used for packaging. | Key Fact: Foam-core board: polystyrene foam sandwiched between card layers - very lightweight, rigid, easy to cut; used for architectural models. | Key Fact: Solid white board: high-quality bleached board, 200+ gsm - smooth surface for printing and packaging.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain why corrugated board is used for packaging rather than solid cardboard of the same weight. | A designer needs to create a 3D architectural model. Justify the choice of foam-core board over corrugated board. | Compare the suitability of cartridge paper and layout paper for producing a final design presentation.
